reviews.x: These are amazing. I love the look of these kind of headbands, but I can’t wear them when it’s pure elastic and fabric. Usually they just creep back and back until they slingshot off my head. It’s horrible. But these look so cute and actually stay on my head. They do give me a bit of a headache after a bit, but that’s worth the look honestly. I got so many colors I’m giving some to my sisters. Love love love these!

reviews.t: Wow!! EXTREMELY WELL MADE AND COMFORTABLE!!
reviews.x: These headbands are so well made and the colors are beautiful!! I LOVE them, they are very comfortable on my head, no pinching or hurting!! Truly an amazing value for all of these!! And they stay in your hair, you don't have to worry about them moving or shifting!! I HIGHLY RECOMMEND THESE!!!

I just love this set. I received it just a couple days ago but have already used 4 of them. I usually get headaches when using those and it ends up pressing on the back of the ears but these are supper comfortable. The colors are vivid and as described. Love it. Great for summer.

It didn’t came with mint and coffee colors. Very comfortable, great quality, great price ,  and fast shipping , but I’m very disappointed I didn’t get 2 hairbands and mint was my favorite one :-( Update : great costumer service !!

reviews.t: Very good fit - no discomfort even after all day
reviews.x: Nice fit and quite the selection for a low price

I love these, they are great quality and great bang for your buck.  They are plastic headbands, but a soft plastic that I was able to mold slightly and make loose on my head (like I like to wear headbands -- no headband headache!).  BUY THEM.
excelente calidad y precio. Quede encantada

I bought this bulk of hair bands and I am very happy of my purchase they are soft very comfortable not too tight on the head, the colors are beautiful and the fabric is wonderful too soft and smooth. I am going to enjoy wearing them for a long time as the quality is great and the hair bands are elegant  enough to were them to work and match them with my cloths. Thank you and keep up the good quality products. Nana

The fit is perfect. I love the look of turban wrapped around my hair, but the real scarfs always fall out of place, this way you have the look and it stays securely tucked in place and you forget you are even wearing it, til you get all the compliments. Great value and high quality.
I liked these because they were solid colors.  They are comfortable and what a great price.
This bundle is great the varite of colors
My hair is thinning at the top and these headbands are not only a statement, it camouflages the thin spots :) I love the variety in colors - I can match pretty much every outfit ! Thank you
I love these headbands! All colors are true to the photos and these are quite comfortable to wear. They look really cute with my long pixie haircut!

reviews.t: Buy them!! Don’t hurt at all!
reviews.x: I have a TERRIBLE time with headbands but these rock. I don’t know if my head is shaped weird or what but elastic or tie around headbands do not stay on at all. Probably doesn’t help that my head is huge (seriously my husband won’t let me forget this fact). I work at a hospital and even after 12 hour shifts these don’t hurt behind my ears or give me headaches. Love them!! So many compliments on them as well. They are thicker so they were a little awkward to wear my glasses over but it turned out
This product says you won’t have pressure pain.  I did.  This product doesn’t stay in place.  It kept sliding towards my face.  Within 2 hours, I wanted to toss it in the trash.  Not good!
These arrived in all different sizes , some of them so bent and broken they are not usable . Terrible product

Really cute headbands. A few issues with quality. Good price for the number you get. Some are smaller than others bc of the way they are packaged for shipment. I got all 10 different colors. No problems with them being too tight and I have a pretty large dome piece (head).

These headbands are not nearly as vividly striking as the picture. I decided to keep them, as they seemed to be comfortable. After wearing them for a while, they have taken on a new role, and one that works very well for me, but maybe not for the many. I have a very small head. However, these headbands still crawl up, much the same as a tank or cami when pushed beyond their limits. They were definitely designed for younger girls or very petite women. Just received these today and am bummed cause I only received 9 out of the 10. Can't seem to find the option to contact seller.  First impression though is ok. Some of the knots are off centered but seem fixable. The headbands are not tight which is great but the ribbons are the ends are kind of pokey behind the ears. Hoping I can resolve the issue of missing one. Will edit if its solved.

reviews.t: Nice but did not fit right
reviews.x: These  headbands are ok but I think they are meant for younger girls or women with petite/smaller heads - they were arched a little oddly and did not land on the right part of my head - they sit comfortably much more forward (near my forehead) than I wanted and when I tried to push them back, it didn’t fit right.  I haven’t had this issue with other headbands so I had to return them

reviews.t: great quality for its price, looks just as advertised
reviews.x: It looks just as advertised and its great quality for its price. Came in all the colors. If you are looking for these kind of headbands, I highly recommend these. The only con is a slight bad smell ( but its slight enough that I imagine once you wear them a few times it will go away or just try using febreeze). Highly recommend for anyone trying to get the most bang for their buck.

These headbands are much too long! Their length interferes with masks and glasses, and pinches one's head. Moreover, they could have chosen better colors. These are dull and muted, and really odd choices (brown mustard  yellow? Seasick green?)  I got a head and earache every time I wore these, so I gave up on them. I would not recommend them to anyone.

These are great! You won’t regret buying them! I’ve been looking for a few headbands to wear when I don’t feel like washing my hair but they’re all usually uncomfortable. These never cause me any pain and the colors are great!! Everyone always asks me where I got them when I wear them out. Such a great find!

These are perfect!  Not too puffy and are so comfortable- I usually stay away from headband because of the headaches they would cause.  Decided to try these out due to the reviews about comfort.  So true!  They are so comfortable for all day wear.  Totally 100% recommend!

Value you’d expect for the price, but they’ve held up so far, and look better than expected when on. I’ve been wearing a different one every day, there’s one to go with every outfit. I’m a picky buyer but definitely happy with this purchase!

claims.text: Most reviewers find the headbands comfortable, with many noting they don't cause pinching or headaches.
Reviewers frequently praise the quality and value, calling them well made and a great price for the bundle.
Many reviewers love the variety and beauty of the colors, saying they match the photos and outfits.
Several reviewers highlight that the headbands stay securely in place without slipping or shifting.
A few reviewers report discomfort or slipping, including headaches and the band sliding toward the face.
